data.name: Shibli
data.long_meaning: Shibli is a name derived from the Arabic word "shabili" meaning a noble companion or friend. In Islamic tradition, it refers to the companions of the Prophet Muhammad.

in_arabic.name: شبل
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يُشير إلى الحمية والحيوية والجريء
in_arabic.long_meaning: الاسم شبل يأتي من الجذور العربية ش-ب-ل، وتعني الحمية والحيوية والجريء، ويرجع تأسيسه إلى العصر الإسلامي المبكر، حيث كان شبل يُستخدم لوصف الشخص الجريء والمحارب، وكان أيضًا اسم لعدد من الصحابة، ومن أشهرهم شبل بن حاتم الأنصاري، الذي كان من أصحاب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، وشارك في العديد من المعارك، وهو معروف بجرأته وحيوته، والاسم شبل له أهمية كبيرة في الإسلام، حيث يرمز إلى الجريء والمحارب، ويتوافق مع القيمة الإسلامية التي تنبأت بها من خلال قوله تعالى "فَلا تَهِنوا وَتَدَعُوَنِ" سورة الأعراف: 128

in_hindi.meaning: नाम जिसका अर्थ है ज़ोरदार और गतिशील
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम शبل का अर्थ है जोरदार और गतिशील, यह नाम इस्लामी काल से ही मौजूद है, यह नाम जोशीले और बहादुर लोगों के लिए उपयोग किया जाता था, श्रीमंत शिबली नाम से जुड़े कई साहबा के नाम थे, जिनमें से एक श्रीमंत शिबली हैं, जिन्होंने कई युद्धों में भाग लिया और बहादुरी का परिचय दिया, इस्लामी समाज में नाम शबल बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है, जो कि बहादुर और लोहा धारी के नाम के रूप में उपयोग होता है, नाम शबल इस्लाम ने बताया है, "कोई कमजोर न हो और न ही डरे, सूरह अल-अराफ 128"

in_english.name: Shibli
in_english.meaning: a name that refers to vitality and boldness
in_english.long_meaning: The name Shibli originates from the Arabic roots Sh-B-L, meaning vitality and boldness, and dates back to the early Islamic era, where Shibli was used to describe the brave and warrior, and was also the name of several companions, one of whom was Shibli bin Hâtîm al-Ansârî, who was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad, and participated in many battles, known for his bravery and vitality, the name Shibli has great importance in Islam, as it symbolizes the brave and warrior, and is in line with the Islamic value of "do not falter and supplicate", Sûre-i Âl-i İmran 123

data.cultural_impact: The name "Shibli" represents a deep sense of loyalty, friendship, and companionship, which are valued virtues in Islamic culture. The name's origin as a title for the noble companions of the Prophet Muhammad highlights the importance of camaraderie and solidarity in the Islamic community. It is also a reminder of the close bonds that were formed during the early days of Islam.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Shibli" holds spiritual significance as it signifies being a noble companion in the service of God. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that the Prophet Muhammad and his companions were the closest of companions, who were devoted to their faith and obedient to God's commands. By bearing the name "Shibli," an individual can strive to emulate these companions in their daily life and seek to strengthen their spiritual connection with God. It is a reminder to be loyal to God and to follow the path of righteousness.
